summary: Verified new PMC-officer escrow signing surface in Staff Portal + signed-PDF download. Backend endpoints (signatures listing, docusign-url, docusign/refresh, signed-document) scoped by pmc_officer.email work correctly; cross-officer access returns 403. Frontend renders staff-escrow-signatures section with both seeded transactions, all target data-testids present, buttons wired to API, graceful toasts on DocuSign test envelope responses (no crash), signed PDF downloads successfully as PMC-Escrow-Signed-TMP.pdf. EMD-paid queue with Accept/Reject still renders.

issues: Secondary 'Refresh DocuSign' button text and the awaiting-signature chips ('You (PMC) · awaiting', 'Institution · awaiting') render in a very pale gray on near-white card/amber card backgrounds — contrast appears borderline for WCAG AA. Section/row primary text (bid ref, vendor, amount, institution) is readable; the ghost/secondary button and awaiting chips should be strengthened.

action_items: Consider darkening the 'Refresh DocuSign' secondary button text and the 'awaiting' signature chip text for better contrast on the light (#eef2f7) and amber pending card backgrounds.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend auth scoping on /api/v1/staff/escrow/transactions/{tid}* correctly returns 403 (verified with mfatest officer).
DocuSign refresh failure returns HTTP 424 and the UI surfaces a clear, non-crashing error toast — good error handling.
'Open in DocuSign' fallback (test envelope id) correctly displays info toast telling user to open the DocuSign email — no crash.
test_credentials: escrow@pmcmanagers.com / Escrow@123 (Escrow Agent); mfatest@pmcmanagers.com / Escrow@123 (Escrow Agent, cross-officer).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded TMP-SIGN-PENDING and TMP-SIGN-DONE transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified via curl: GET /api/v1/staff/escrow/signatures (200, returns pending + transactions); GET /api/v1/staff/escrow/transactions/{tid}/signed-document (200 with base64 PDF); cross-officer access returns 403. Frontend verified via Playwright on https://pmc-forest-green.preview.emergentagent.com/staff — all data-testids present (staff-dashboard, staff-escrow-signatures, staff-escrow-sign-TMP-SIGN-PENDING, staff-escrow-refresh-TMP-SIGN-PENDING, staff-escrow-download-TMP-SIGN-DONE). DocuSign test envelope IDs produce graceful info/error toasts. Only outstanding feedback is minor contrast on secondary button and awaiting chips.
